mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sso_connection (org_id, protocol, enabled, enforce_sso, jit_workspace_id, default_role, oidc_issuer, oidc_client_id, oidc_client_secret_enc, oidc_scopes, saml_idp_entity_id, saml_sso_url, saml_idp_metadata_xml, saml_idp_x509, saml_sp_private_key_enc, saml_sp_certificate) VALUES (#{orgId}, #{protocol}, #{enabled}, #{enforceSso}, #{jitWorkspaceId}, #{defaultRole}, #{oidcIssuer}, #{oidcClientId}, #{oidcClientSecretEnc}, #{oidcScopes}, #{samlIdpEntityId}, #{samlSsoUrl}, #{samlIdpMetadataXml}, #{samlIdpX509}, #{samlSpPrivateKeyEnc}, #{samlSpCertificate}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE protocol = VALUES(protocol), enabled = VALUES(enabled), enforce_sso = VALUES(enforce_sso), jit_workspace_id = VALUES(jit_workspace_id), default_role = VALUES(default_role), oidc_issuer = VALUES(oidc_issuer), oidc_client_id = VALUES(oidc_client_id), oidc_client_secret_enc = COALESCE(#{oidcClientSecretEnc}, oidc_client_secret_enc), oidc_scopes = VALUES(oidc_scopes), saml_idp_entity_id = VALUES(saml_idp_entity_id), saml_sso_url = VALUES(saml_sso_url), saml_idp_metadata_xml = VALUES(saml_idp_metadata_xml), saml_idp_x509 = VALUES(saml_idp_x509), saml_sp_private_key_enc = COALESCE(#{samlSpPrivateKeyEnc}, saml_sp_private_key_enc), saml_sp_certificate = COALESCE(#{samlSpCertificate}, saml_sp_certificate)
